title: AI in Workflows: Automate with AI Tasks and Chat Events | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Orchard Core workflows automate work without code. The AI features of CrestApps for Orchard Core add two tasks that ask an AI model for an answer, and four events that start a workflow when something happens in an AI chat. This video builds a workflow that summarizes every chat when it ends, and explains the outcomes and the events.

In this video:
• What the AI adds to workflows: two tasks, four events, three outcomes
• Creating a workflow
• Starting it from an AI chat event
• Adding the AI Completion using Profile task
• Connecting the steps on the canvas
• AI Completion using Direct Config
• The four chat events, and use cases
